summary: Ran `ng update @angular/core@10 @angular/cli@10 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp (with NG_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 to stop the CLI from trying to self-bootstrap the true npm 'latest' @angular/cli, which now requires Node 22+ and cannot run on this hop's Node 12). The update bumped the Angular packages to 10.2.5, the CLI toolchain to 10.2.4, TypeScript to 4.0.8, tslib to 2.x, and ran Angular's own migrations (renamed browserslist to .browserslistrc, updated tslint config to v6 rules, removed deprecated vendorChunk/es5BrowserSupport angular.json options, updated tsconfig module/target options, checked for ModuleWithProviders/Injectable/undecorated-class issues). No related third-party packages required a version bump for this hop (none detected). Install and build pass; the test command fails the same way it did at baseline (karma's test target points at a nonexistent root-level `styles.css` instead of `src/styles.css`), so no new regression was introduced.
changes: Upgraded typescript from ~3.8.3 to ~4.0.8, tslib from ^1.10.0 to ^2.0.0

Upgraded devDependencies jasmine-core, jasmine-spec-reporter, karma, karma-chrome-launcher, karma-coverage-istanbul-reporter, karma-jasmine, karma-jasmine-html-reporter to versions compatible with Angular 10
Upgraded optionalDependencies protractor (~5.4.0 -> ~7.0.0) and tslint (~5.9.1 -> ~6.1.0) as part of the workspace dependency update migration

Angular CLI migrations: renamed browserslist to .browserslistrc, updated tslint.json to v6 rules (dropped no-use-before-declare, which is removed in tslint 6) and added the tslint deprecation rule, removed deprecated vendorChunk options from angular.json, removed deprecated es5BrowserSupport builder option, updated tsconfig.json module to es2020 and src/tsconfig.server.json to use target es2016 instead of module commonjs
Angular core migrations for @Injectable enforcement, ModuleWithProviders generics, and undecorated classes found nothing in this codebase that needed changing
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of `ng update`
manual_followups: npm install still prints peer-dependency warnings for @ngrx/* (^8.5.2), @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 and codelyzer@5.2.2, which declare peers on @angular/core@^8 (or ^7, or <10.0.0); this hop's detection again found no required bump for them, but they should be moved to Angular-10-compatible majors in a later hop.

npx's bundled 'ng update' call required NG_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 to avoid a self-upgrade check that compares the installed CLI against npm's true 'latest' @angular/cli (now a much newer major requiring Node 22+); later hops running on older pinned Node versions will likely need the same workaround.

The optional node-sass@4.11.0 dependency still fails to build its native binding on this Node 12 environment (missing python2 / no prebuilt binary for this ABI), same as at baseline; it does not fail npm install because it's an optionalDependency.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target references `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present in the baseline angular.json) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.
